### Observed differences

- Four activities that were not observed in any earlier trace appear in the later window: A02 and A13 each take part in about 48 in 100 traces, A09 and A12 each in about 26 in 100. A02 occurs roughly twice per trace that contains it (it recurs in about 26 in 100 traces), A12 similarly, while A13 occurs exactly once when present. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]
- A01, which appeared in about 20 in 100 earlier traces and was always followed by A04, is not observed at all in the later window. [OCC001, DIR001]
- A03's routing changed: earlier, about 52 in 100 of its outgoing transitions went to A08 and about 46 in 100 went directly to A04; in the later window about 52 in 100 still go to A08, but about 46 in 100 now go to A02, and the direct transition to A04 has nearly vanished (about 1 in 100). [DIR003]
- The new block is wired as follows in the later window: A02's outgoing transitions go to A12 (about 54 in 100) or A13 (about 45 in 100), A12 leads back to A02 (about 99 in 100), and A13 leads to A04 (about 99 in 100). [DIR002, DIR006, DIR007]
- Ordering within the new block: A03 precedes A13 in about 47 in 100 later traces; A02 and A13 co-occur in about 48 in 100 traces (A02 first in about 22 in 100, interleaved or repeated in about 26 in 100); A02 and A12 co-occur in about 26 in 100 traces, always interleaved or repeated rather than in one fixed order. [REL017, REL013, REL012]
- Downstream effects: A04 still occurs in every trace in both windows, but later in the trace (median position about 0.58 of the trace earlier vs about 0.75 later); A03 → A04 pairs within five steps now cluster at distances 3 and 5 (about 39 in 100 each) instead of at distance 1 (about 24 in 100 earlier). [POS003, LAG001]
- A08's self-loop (about 43 in 100 of its outgoing transitions earlier) is gone; in the later window A08 sends about 45 in 100 of its outgoing transitions to A09, and A09 leads back to A08 in all of its observed outgoing transitions. Where they co-occur (about 26 in 100 traces) they are interleaved or repeated, and A08's self-repetitions now occur at distance 2 rather than 1. [DIR004, DIR005, REL021, LAG003]
- A14 switched targets: earlier all of its observed outgoing transitions went to A01, in the later window all go to A04; accordingly the A14 → A04 distance within five steps shrinks from mostly 2 steps (about 43 in 100) to mostly 1 step (about 41 in 100). [DIR008, LAG004]
- The two new behaviour blocks are mutually exclusive: A02 never co-occurs with A09, and A09 never co-occurs with A12, in the later window. [REL011, REL024]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that a new segment of activities now runs between A03 and A04 in roughly half of the later executions: A03 frequently passes to A02, which either continues to A13 and then A04, or first loops through A12 back to A02 before reaching A13 and A04. A02, A12 and A13 were not observed in the earlier window, the direct A03 → A04 route that carried about 46 in 100 of A03's outgoing transitions has almost disappeared, and A04 now takes place later in the trace. The control-flow family produced 54 qualifying items against fewer than 1 expected if nothing had changed, so the pattern as a whole is not what an unchanged process typically produces, and occurrence, routing, ordering and position indicators all describe the same structure. [OCC002, DIR003, DIR002, DIR007, REL017, POS003, LAG001]

The items are not independent confirmations, since occurrence, direction, position and several relation items summarise the same traces. The evidence also cannot show whether the new segment runs in all cases or only in a subset (for example particular case types), and it cannot rule out that the two windows capture different case mixes rather than a modified single flow. [OCC002, DIR002, REL013]

Other differences: A08's self-loop is replaced by an interleaved A08–A09 exchange in about a quarter of later traces, and A01 is no longer observed while A14 now connects directly to A04 (previously A14 led to A01 and A01 to A04). These fit the same kind of addition and removal of activities but are kept separate from the main hypothesis. [DIR004, DIR005, OCC001, DIR008, LAG004]
